title.zh: French Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget
title.en: French Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget

current_state.zh: France's National Assembly Finance Committee approved amendments to tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps and impose a crypto exit tax on wealthy households, then rejected the budget's entire revenue section, sending the government's original text to the floor.
current_state.en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee approved amendments to tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps and impose a crypto exit tax on wealthy households, then rejected the budget's entire revenue section, sending the government's original text to the floor.
